passages.text:
Re: You Tube Creative Cohorts and opportunities for LAC
[contact omitted] Joshua Machleder Tuesday, July 19,2022 at 8:27:52 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
fantastic. thanks!
On Tue, Jul 19, 2022 at 2:26 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Yes. I told YT about LAC, but feel free to share.
On Tue, Jul 19, 2022 at 7:50 AM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Great. I'Il join RDMA for a call with internews later this week (time difference is easy to accommodate in Belgrade)
and l'll report back to you on any issues that come up. One question for you: is it OK to share the concept note from
YOuTube with Internews? RDMA wanted to, but I said that we should hold off until l've cleared that with you.
On Tue, 19 Jul 2022 at 13:31, Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Yes. Let's do it
On Tue, Jul 19, 2022 at 2:12 AM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Vera, hey,
Are you still potentially interested in seeing if the "creative cohorts" could work in Asia. RDMA is interested in
exploring the idea further. They would like to talk to internews, which is doing a regional disinformation program.
Let me know if you'd like them to proceed. Best, J
On Tue, 19 Jul 2022 at 04:58, Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey All,
So a couple of things. On the trainings for DOCs - here is the info:
"We offer a standard "how you tube works" 30 to 45 min lesson that we offer for civic partners in the US and
around the world. We recently did one for all US Senate Press Secretaries. It could be live, in dc, regional,
virtual etc."
My recommendation is we ID a few missions to test this out - Pls let me know which ones might resonate.
On the creative cohorts, please see here YT's updated proposal and let me know what you think. Again, I
would think piloting this in 1 or 2 countries would be ideal. Obviously a bright spot country like Ecuador or
Brazil given its overall importance may make sense - but | leave it to you, the real experts!
Please review the proposal linked above! It has been updated.
Many thanks! vera
On Mon, Jul 18, 2022 at 12:38 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera—I can speak to the training part. I plan on sharing this information with all of our DOCs so a general
description of the training will do. Thanks for following up!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Sun, Jul 17, 2022 at 10:51 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear All,
I'm going to respond to YT shortly, but regarding both training for DOCs and creator cohorts, are there
specific countries that you would be interested in exploring? I was thinking Brazil (given its importance),
Ecuador and Honduras (bright spots) might be contenders. However, I am totally agnostic - so welcome
your regional perspective. Please let me know so that | can steer YT into the right direction.
Thanks! Vera

On Wed, Jul 13, 2022 at 5:29 PM Chelsea Milko <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks for sharing!
+Nabila Baptiste for viz on the Marcela ask.
As for the offer to provide YT training to our DOCs, that all sounds really interesting and useful. I'd like
to share the details of the training with them and gauge levels of interest. Would you mind providing a
succinct description of what the training entails? I know many of our Mission-level communicators
are YT savvy already so it would be good to understand how we can tailor this to their needs and
interests.
Looking forward to learning more! Thanks much!
Chelsea Milko
Sr. Communications Advisor
Strategy and Program Office (SPO)
USAID | Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
On Wed, Jul 13, 2022 at 10:37 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Great.
Please let me know if there's a real interest and I'm happy to set something up to explore.
YT analytics is for creators to see through analytics the extent of their audience and how far their
reach is. So this is part of their training.
Please let me know and I'm happy to put you all in touch with YT and be there as well. They would
love to do this before the calendar year and would be great to see if there's an opportunity here.
On Wed, Jul 13, 2022 at 10:33 AM Luis Azurduy <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds interesting. LAC is revamping its comms team (copied) so I'm sure someone will be
interested in participating. We also have partnerships w journalist and journalist associations so
happy to spread the word.
Also, what is YT's "backed analytics"?
On Tue, Jul 12, 2022 at 10:11 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Luis,
I hope you are doing well!
Josh Machleder and I met with You Tube a number of weeks ago on ways we might potentially
be able to partner with them on a number of initiatives. First of all, we have a single point of
contact (Josh Blumenfeld) who can address most issues for us. Second, YT has offered to do
trainings for USAID communicators (ie DOCs) in the region on effective use of YT. Finally, they
are looking to do an interesting partnership with us, called Creator Cohort. Since AA Escobari
has engaged with YT as well, I thought there might be some interest in LAC? The idea would be
at the country / regional level to convene 25 creators / journalists that could be provided with
start-up funds, equipment, and training on YT's backed analytics. YT would love to explore
doing this by the end of the calendar year. Is this something of interest to you and others at
Thanks so much, and please let me know! Feel free to tag others.
Vera
Luis Azurduy
Team Lead, Democracy, Human Rights and Governance

Office of Regional Sustainable Development
Bureau for Latin America and the Caribbean
United States Agency forInternational Development (USAID)

trainings for USAID communicators (ie DOCs) in the region on effective use of YT. Finally, they
are looking to do an interesting partnership with us, called Creator Cohort. Since AA Escobari
has engaged with YT as well, I thought there might be some interest in LAC? The idea would be
at the country / regional level to convene 25 creators / journalists that could be provided with
start-up funds, equipment, and training on YT's backed analytics. YT would love to explore
doing this by the end of the calendar year. Is this something of interest to you and others at
Thanks so much, and please let me know! Feel free to tag others.
Vera
Luis Azurduy
Team Lead, Democracy, Human Rights and Governance
